resources.string: 返回手势诊断 / Back gesture diagnostics
独立窗口中的原始系统回调 / Raw platform callbacks in a separate window

缓慢从屏幕边缘滑入并停留，再滑回边缘取消；然后重复并松手完成。

Slowly swipe from the screen edge, hold, then return to the edge to cancel. Repeat and release to complete.

此页面直接记录系统回调，不经过 AndroidX 或 NavHost。取消和完成均停留在此页面；invoked 表示系统完成返回。

This page records platform callbacks without AndroidX or NavHost. Both cancellation and completion keep this page open; invoked means the system completed back.

关闭后，在「关于」中选择「保存返回调试日志」。此测试不直接跟踪正常页面的 NavHost 回调。

Close, then use Save back debug logs in About. This test does not trace normal NavHost callbacks.
